tool-reinspection.title: Recheck the original tool configuration
tool-reinspection.boundary: This requests a report from the selected node's existing configuration. Saving the request, accepting its inventory and verifying the tool are separate facts. It does not install, change or enable a tool.
tool-reinspection.empty: No recheck request is recorded for this profile.
tool-reinspection.original_pending: The creation receipt is unconfirmed. Keep the original configuration, request body and operation ID; explicitly recover that receipt before creating another request.
tool-reinspection.intent_unavailable: The original recheck operation could not be safely stored or recovered. Keep the original record and retry reading before making a new request.
tool-reinspection.invalid_read: The recheck response does not match its original source or the public contract.
tool-reinspection.access_denied: Current access to this recheck is unavailable. Read again to verify the current account and project.
tool-reinspection.changed: This request belongs to a different revision or node. Its original source is retained; review the current profile separately.
tool-reinspection.background_paused: Automatic status reading is paused. Read the original request explicitly to continue.
tool-reinspection.state.pending: Request saved; waiting for the original node.
tool-reinspection.state.claimed: The original node claimed this request. A completed report has not been confirmed.
tool-reinspection.state.completed: The inventory associated with this request was accepted. Review the original configuration for its current availability.
tool-reinspection.state.failed: The node reported that inspection did not start. The request is retained.
tool-reinspection.state.unknown: The machine result is unconfirmed. Read this original request; do not start another inspection.
tool-reinspection.state.expired: The unclaimed request expired. No completed report is recorded.
tool-reinspection.state.superseded: The request's source changed. This request grants no new execution authority.
tool-reinspection.result.reported_availa: The accepted report observed the configuration as available; model authentication and execution remain separate.
tool-reinspection.result.reported_unavai: The accepted report observed the configuration as unavailable.
tool-reinspection.result.profile_changed: The reported configuration differs from the original profile.
tool-reinspection.result.command_missing: The original command is absent from the accepted inventory.
tool-reinspection.result.probe_interrupt: The inspection was interrupted; its complete result is unknown.
tool-reinspection.result.probe_timeout: The inspection timed out; its complete result is unknown.
tool-reinspection.result.probe_failed: A complete inspection result could not be confirmed.
tool-reinspection.result.not_started: The node confirmed inspection did not start.
tool-reinspection.result.request_expired: The request expired before a claim.
tool-reinspection.result.source_changed: The original authorization, node or configuration source changed.
tool-reinspection.state.closed_unknown: The maintenance occupancy is released; the original inspection result remains unknown. A new inspection needs a separate explicit request.
tool-reinspection.maintenance.title: Node maintenance capability
tool-reinspection.maintenance.boundary: Reported by this node's continuous inventory owner. Capability does not prove online status, tool availability, model authentication or original process termination.
tool-reinspection.maintenance.state.expi: Capability observation expired; current support is unconfirmed
tool-reinspection.maintenance.state.unsu: The reported protocol is unsupported by this version
tool-reinspection.recovery.title: Reconcile unknown maintenance occupancy
tool-reinspection.recovery.boundary: This five-minute purpose authorization applies only to the original maintenance occupancy. The node must provide its original durable stop proof and accept the receipt. It does not probe again, terminate processes or enable tools.
tool-reinspection.recovery.authorize: Reconcile and release this maintenance occupancy
tool-reinspection.recovery.confirm: Authorize reconciliation of this exact original request for five minutes? The server verifies current approval authority. Saving authorization does not prove that stop evidence was obtained or occupancy released.
tool-reinspection.recovery.no_authorizat: The original unknown inspection has no reconciliation authorization.
tool-reinspection.recovery.original_pend: The original authorization creation receipt is unconfirmed. Recover its original body and operation ID first.
tool-reinspection.recovery.state.request: Purpose authorization saved; waiting for the original node. Occupancy is not released.
tool-reinspection.recovery.state.proof_s: The server stored the original stop proof. Waiting for the node to durably accept its exact receipt; occupancy is not released.
tool-reinspection.recovery.state.closed_: The node durably accepted the receipt and occupancy is released; the original inspection result remains unknown.
tool-reinspection.recovery.state.expired: This reconciliation authorization expired. Original occupancy and unknown facts are retained.
tool-reinspection.recovery.proof_missing: Complete original stop proof is absent; occupancy is retained. An administrator must review original identity isolation or pairing. Do not delete journals or release occupancy based on a timeout.
tool-reinspection.recovery.capability_re: The exact original node needs a last-known supported maintenance protocol declaration. Registration, online status or another node's capability cannot substitute.
tool-reinspection.recovery.proof: Original stop proof and receipt digest
tool-reinspection.recovery.proof_facts: Probe return, all original native trees stopped and no pending inventory come from the verified proof. The unknown inspection result does not change.
tool-reinspection.recovery.invalid_read: The reconciliation response does not match the original source, digest or stop proof.
tool-reinspection.recovery.intent_unavai: The original reconciliation intent cannot be safely stored or recovered. Keep the original record and reconcile later.
tool-reinspection.recovery.access_denied: Current reconciliation access is unavailable. Protected content is hidden and the original intent is retained.
